interests: Supernatural thrillers blending real-world science and history with high-stakes suspense, featuring protagonists who navigate dangerous environments like dense forests or crumbling mansions while confronting credible yet terrifying threats.

Atmospheric horror stories set in isolated locations such as old-growth forests or haunted houses, focusing on the psychological tension between characters desperate for shelter and malevolent forces that emerge after darkness falls.

Fantasy-horror narratives inspired by mythology and folklore, where classic quest sagas intertwine with terrifying elements to create worlds of magic, legend, and lore that appeal to young adult audiences.
